description: Canonical NotFoundError corpus. HTTP 404 surfaces as the SDK's NotFoundError (a distinct class from AuthError/ValidationError/RateLimitError/ServerError). Cross-partner access returns 404 (NEVER 403) to avoid leaking customer existence (existence-non-leak convention). The uniform 404 handler may rewrite the body to {"error":"not_found",...} app-wide; tests should accept either the route-level code or the uniform 'not_found'.

cases.name: customer_not_found
cases.message: No customer found for the given id under the calling partner.
cases.parity_note: Cross-partner access (PARTNER_B accessing PARTNER_A's customer) also returns 404 customer_not_found, never 403.

cases.name: agent_not_found
cases.message: No active agent found for the given id under the calling org.

cases.name: capability_not_found
cases.message: No capability token found for the given id owned by the caller's org.
cases.parity_note: No cross-org capability detail is leaked in the body.

cases.name: webhook_not_found
cases.message: No webhook found for the given id under the calling org.

cases.name: revocation_target_not_found
cases.message: No revocable target found for the given target_id under the calling org.
cases.parity_note: Revoke of an already-revoked target is idempotent (success, no re-cascade); only an UNKNOWN/cross-org target is a 404.

cases.name: session_not_found
cases.message: No active session found for the given customer/session id under the calling partner.

cases.name: envelope_not_found
cases.message: No execution envelope found for the given id under the calling org.

uniform_handler_alias.note: The app-wide uniform 404 handler may rewrite route-level 404 bodies to this shape. Tests should accept EITHER the route-level code (e.g. customer_not_found) OR the uniform 'not_found'. The HTTP status (404) and the existence-non-leak guarantee are always preserved.
